parameters.name: DataCenter
parameters.description: The data center. This value must be the same as the data center specified in [CreateLiveMessageApp](~~2848162~~). Currently supported data centers are Shanghai (cn-shanghai) and Singapore (ap-southeast-1).

parameters.name: GroupStatus
parameters.description:
The group status. Default value: 0. Valid values:
- 0: Queries all groups.
- 1: Queries groups that are not deleted.
- 2: Queries deleted groups.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description:
The page number. Valid values: \[1,10000\].

Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The page size. Valid values: \[1,50\].

Default value: 20.

parameters.name: SortType
parameters.description:
The sort order, based on group creation time. Valid values:
- 1: Ascending order.
- 2: Descending order.
